storage.title: Storage
storage.bar: {app} uses {own}; {used} of {total} on the disk are in use
storage.partial: Not everything counted yet: the numbers are too small.
storage.network: The data folder lies on a network share (NFS or SMB). That can damage {things}. A local disk is better.

backup.title: Backup
backup.keepHint: This many automatic backups stay, older ones go. Backups made by hand or uploaded stay until you delete them.
backup.failed: The backup failed ({when}): {reason}. The older backups stay.
backup.restoreFailed: Restoring failed ({when}). {app} keeps running with the data from before.
backup.uploadedHint: Uploaded. It is in the list now: check it first, then restore.
backup.checkOk: The backup is complete and readable.
backup.checkBad: Damaged: this backup cannot be restored.
backup.checkNewer: This backup comes from {app} {version}, newer than this one. Update {app} first, then restore.
backup.restarting: {app} restarts with the backup. The page reloads in a moment.
backup.archivePasswordHint: The password this backup was encrypted with.

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.text: First the current state is backed up, then {app} restarts and restores the backup. Everybody signs in again afterwards.
restore.textNow: First the current state is backed up, then {app} restores the backup. Everybody signs in again afterwards.

download.title: Download this backup?
download.text: It contains everything {app} knows, with the accounts and the server's key. It is not encrypted.

upload.title: Upload a backup?
upload.text: The file joins the list of backups. Nothing is restored until you confirm it there.

backup.timeHintMonthly: On the 1st of the month, in the server's time zone ({zone}).
backup.downloadPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Without this password the file cannot be opened, not even by us.

error.backup_invalid: This is not a backup of {app}.
error.backup_damaged: The backup is damaged. Nothing was changed.
error.backup_too_new: The backup comes from a newer version of {app}. Nothing was changed.
error.backup_too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
error.backup_disk_full: The disk is full. The older backups stay.
error.backup_write_failed: The backup could not be written. The older backups stay.
error.archive_password_needed: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password.
error.schedule_invalid: Off, every night, every week or every month.
error.archive_password_short: The file's password needs at least 8 characters.
error.restore_options_invalid: These answers do not fit the questions of the restore.
